idempotency_key: sha256(source_version + entity_type + entity_id + event_type + effective_timestamp + client_action_uuid)
rules: store an immutable event before applying it
same key returns prior result without recalculation
amendment has new event type and UUID
snapshot contains seed, event sequence, source versions and state hash
replay sorts by timestamp then event sequence number

given.events: same log except reordered same-day sequence

expected.result: may differ; test must fail if sequence number missing
replay records version mismatch; no silent equivalence assertion

validation: all write paths require idempotency key
replay event count equals original immutable log count
